coordinates: image pixels, x right, y down, origin top-left of the 1920x1080 frame
scene_description: Video is rotated 90 deg: a white wall fills the left ~3/4 of the image, a black baseboard is the vertical strip x~1438-1581, and a light wood floor is at the right (x>1581). Gravity points to image +x (right). A hand at the left edge holds a black zippered pouch against/near the wall, releases it at frame ~66, the pouch falls rightward (pure translation, almost no rotation) to the baseboard/floor, contacts the baseboard at frame 81 and comes to rest on the floor by frame 91.

camera.drift_px: slow drift vs frame 0: dx -1.7..+2.1, dy 0..+5.6 px over the whole clip (phase correlation, tracks/pouch.csv bg_dx,bg_dy); during the fall (frames 66-80) change < 0.5 px total in x - negligible
